false_signal: no receipt inside the wait window

payload.disclosure: The transaction was BROADCAST and no receipt was obtained within the wait window. This is NOT a refusal and NOT a failure — it may be mined. Check the hash before retrying.

fact_source.outranks_because: a later receipt for the same hash

expected.rule: a run that holds a hash is never retried

head_behaviour: Recorded as a broadcast in a log line; no record holds the hash for a later read, so nothing reconciles it.
